Algea.name: Algea
Algea.publicNotes: Algeas protect (y sometimes retrieve) souls at risk de being claimed by otro entities, particularly spellcasters who dabbled con otherworldly forces but never officially pledged su souls.
Algea.saveDetails: +1 bonificador de estado to all saves vs. magic

<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.5bTt2CvYHPvaR7QQ]
Plane Shift (Self and soul caged criaturas only, to the Boneyard only)
spell->Plane Shift (Self and soul caged.target: Self and soul caged criaturas only

Lifesense 60 pies

action->See Magic.name: See Magic
action->See Magic.description: An algea can see magic auras on criaturas or objects that it can observe; it can't see magic auras on criaturas or objects that are hidden from its view. It learns the schools of magic for all conjuros affecting criaturas.

action->Grieving Aura.name: Grieving Aura
action->Grieving Aura.description:
30 pies. A criatura that begins its turn in the aura must attempt a @Check[will|dc:27] save. Undead take a -2 penalización de circunstancia to this tirada de salvación. The criatura is then temporarily immune to the grieving aura for 1 hour.

Éxito The criatura is unaffected.

Fallo For 1 round, the criatura can't use reactions and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Lentificado 1} for that turn as it sobs uncontrollably.

Fallo crítico As failure, but the effects lasts while the criatura remains in the aura plus 1 minute.

action->Drain Magic.name: Drain Magic
action->Drain Magic.description: Siempre que a criatura fails its save against Frenzied Beaks, the algea attempts to counter a conjuro effect active on that criatura (6th level, counteract check +22). The algea can elige which effect to attempt to counteract for each criatura.

action->Frenzied Beaks.name: Frenzied Beaks
action->Frenzied Beaks.description: Each foe in the swarm's space takes @Damage[5d6[piercing]|traits:item:rune:property:ghost-touch] daño (@Check[reflex|dc:30|basic]) and is exposed to drain magic. Este daño affects incorporeal criaturas as if it had the effects of a ghost touch property rune.

action->Soul Cage.name: Jaula del alma
action->Soul Cage.description:
An incorporeal undead damaged by Frenzied Beaks must attempt a @Check[will|dc:30] save.

Éxito crítico The undead is unaffected and is temporarily immune for 24 hours.

Éxito The undead takes a -10-pies penalización de estado to Velocidades for 1 round.

Fallo As success, but the undead is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Inmovilizado} for 1 round, although it can attempt to Escape (DC 30).

Fallo crítico The undead is restrained for 1 round. The algea can attempt to plane shift with the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Neutralizado} criatura even if that criatura isn't willing, but an unwilling criatura can attempt a Will save to resist @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.5bTt2CvYHPvaR7QQ]{Interplanar Teleport}. If it succeeds, the algea plane shifts and leaves the incorporeal criatura behind, which is then no longer restrained.

action->Whispered Despair.name: Whispered Despair
action->Whispered Despair.description:
Desencadenante A criatura with an active emotion effect enters an attic whisperer's aura of sobs

Efecto The attic whisperer attempts to counteract the emotion effect, with a counteract modifier of +13.

action->Aura of Sobs.name: Aura of Sobs
action->Aura of Sobs.description:
10 pies. Anitoli Nostreaema enshrouds itself in a tapestry of stolen voices. Each living criatura that enters or starts their turn in the aura must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:21] save or the unnerving, bitter sobs render them distraught and they become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Anonadado 1} for as long as they remain within the aura. A criatura that succeeds is temporarily immune for 1 hour.

Anitoli Nostreaema can activate or deactivate the aura with a single free action, which has the concentrate rasgo.

action->Steal Breath.name: Steal Breath
action->Steal Breath.description:
Anitoli Nostreaema siphons the breath from living criaturas, sapping their strength. A living criatura hit by a jaws Golpe must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:24] save.

Éxito crítico El objetivo is unaffected.

Éxito El objetivo is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Debilitado 1} for 1 round.

Fallo El objetivo is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Debilitado 1} for 24 hours and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigado}.

Fallo crítico El objetivo is debilitado 1 for 24 hours, is fatigued, and falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Inconsciente}.

action->Steal Voice.name: Robar voz
action->Steal Voice.description:
When Anatoli Nostraema hits a living criatura with a bony hand Golpe, it tries to pull the victim's voice into its aura. The victim must attempt a @Check[will|dc:24] save.

Éxito crítico El objetivo is unaffected.

Éxito El objetivo's voice is weak for 1 minute. Anytime it attempts an action with the auditory rasgo, it must succeed at a @Check[flat|dc:5] check or the action is lost.

Fallo El objetivo loses the ability to speak for 1 hour, until the curse is removed, or until the attic whisperer is destroyed, whichever comes first. During this time, the attic whisperer can perfectly mimic el objetivo's voice, and el objetivo takes a -2 penalización de circunstancia to tiradas de salvación against that attic whisperer's aura of sobs.

Fallo crítico As failure, but the effects lasts until the attic whisperer is destroyed or the curse is removed.

Architect and Hunter.name: Architect and Hunter
Architect and Hunter.description: Un ghostly pair de teenagers-el Xarwin twins-cry out en pain as su brains son replaced into su cabezas. As si su trauma reverses, el initial pain fades y ellos express el desire a play.
Architect and Hunter.disable: @Check[performance|dc:21|name:Distract the Haunt] (entrenado) to distract the haunt and entertain it until it becomes soothed or @Check[religion|dc:25|name:Exorcise Haunt] (entrenado) to exorcise the haunt
Architect and Hunter.reset: The haunt resets automatically 1 hour after it's defeated or after no living criaturas remain in the area to play with. Removing Marney's and Mira's brains from the brain collector statue in area E9 destroys the haunt.
Architect and Hunter.routine: (2 actions) The architect (Mira Xarwin) uses Shackled Memories to cause a strange, house-like cage of solid ectoplasm to spring up around a randomly determined target. Este house bears an uncanny resemblance to the home el objetivo grew up in. The hunter (Marney Xarwin) then attempts a hunting shot Golpe at that target.

action->Brain Pain.name: Brain Pain
action->Brain Pain.description:
Desencadenante One round passes after a living criatura opens the door to either of the children's rooms

Efecto Both doors to the rooms open violently as the PCs experience visions of the twins having the tops of their heads cut away by unseen blades, followed by the ghastly sight of brains being placed into the empty skulls within. All criaturas in either C14a, C14b, or in the hallway outside the rooms must attempt a @Check[will|dc:24] save. The haunt then rolls initiative.

Éxito crítico The criatura is unaffected.

Éxito The criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Indispuesto 1} by the pain.

Fallo The criatura takes @Damage[(2d8+9)[mental]] daño and increases their malevolence value by 1.

Fallo crítico The criatura takes @Damage[(4d8+9)[mental]] daño, is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Aturdido 1} by the pain, and increases their malevolence value by 2.

action->Shackled Memories.name: Shackled Memories
action->Shackled Memories.description:
El objetivo believes a miniature version of their childhood home has built up around them, locking them in place. El objetivo must attempt a @Check[will|dc:24] save.

Éxito crítico El objetivo is unaffected and is temporarily immune to Shackled Memories for 24 hours.

Éxito El objetivo is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} until the end of their next turn.

Fallo El objetivo is desprevenido and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Inmovilizado} until the end of their next turn.

Fallo crítico El objetivo is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Neutralizado} for 1 minute or until they Escape.

strike-melee->Hunting Shot.name: Hunting Shot
strike-melee->Hunting Shot.description: El objetivo imagines they're bleeding to death.

Carrion Vortex.name: Carrion Vortex
Carrion Vortex.description: El countless huesos y feathers en el suelo churn into el air en un clattering swarm de partially reconstructed skeletal birds, whose mournful song fills el area as surely as do su slashing beaks y talons.
Carrion Vortex.disable: @Check[nature|dc:23|name:Convince Carrion Tú Pose No Threat] to convince the carrion vortex that the PCs pose no ill intent or @Check[religion|dc:20|name:Exorcise the Haunt] to exorcise the haunt
Carrion Vortex.reset: 24 horas; defeating el corrupted psychopomps en areas D5 y E4 destroys este haunt forever.
Carrion Vortex.routine: (1 action; evocation, occult) The churning vortex of beaks and bones takes its action through area D2, clawing and pecking at any criatura in the area. All criaturas in area D2 take @Damage[(2d8+9)[slashing]] daño (@Check[reflex|dc:24|basic|traits:evocation,occult] save).

action->Psychopomp Dirge.name: Psychopomp Dirge
action->Psychopomp Dirge.description:
Desencadenante Three or more criaturas enter area D2, or anyone attempts to gather or destroy the bird remains

Efecto The carrion vortex fills area D2 with the overwhelming cries of what sounds like thousands of whippoorwills, but this cacophony can't be heard beyond this room. Las criaturas in area D2 must attempt a @Check[will|dc:21] save. (worshipers of Pharasma or those with ties to psychopomps gain a +4 bonificador de circunstancia to this save).The haunt then rolls initiative.

Éxito crítico The criatura understands the dirge is also intended as a warning and a desperate request for absolution. The criatura can sense the presence of the corrupted psychopomps in areas D5 and E4 as if under the effects of a locate conjuro, for 24 hours. As long as this effect persists, the character gains a +1 bonificador de estado to tiradas de ataque, tiradas de salvación, and pruebas de habilidad made against the corrupted psychopomps in these areas.

Éxito As critical success, but the locate effect only lasts 10 minutes. The criatura takes @Damage[2d8[mental]] daño from overwhelming feelings of sadness and despair.

Fallo The criatura takes @Damage[4d8[mental]] daño from overwhelming feelings of sadness and despair.

Fallo crítico The criatura takes @Damage[6d8[mental]] daño from overwhelming feelings of sadness and despair, and as long as the haunt remains active and they remain in area D2, the character is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Lentificado 1} as they're forced to do nothing but sob for one action every round.

action->Lifesense 60 feet.name:
<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.sebk9XseMCRkDqRg]
Lifesense 60 pies

action->Corrupted Touch.name: Corrupted Touch
action->Corrupted Touch.description: A corrupted nosoi's Golpes deal @Damage[1d6[void]] daño to living criaturas. A criatura critically hit by a corrupted nosoi's Golpe must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:18] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drenado 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drenado 2} on a critical failure) as rot spreads through their flesh.

action->Haunting Melody.name: Haunting Melody
action->Haunting Melody.description:
The nosoi croons "the Lord slumbers below, estás nothing but his dreams, and when the lord awakes, tú'll know the end of things!". Each living or undead criatura within a @Template[emanation|distance:60] must attempt a @Check[will|dc:18] save. The effect lasts for 1 round, but a nosoi can use this ability again on subsequent rounds to extend the duration by 1 round for all affected criaturas. A criatura that succeeds at any save is temporarily immune for 24 hours. Despite being a mental effect, this ability affects mindless undead. Psychopomps are immune to this ability.

Fallo The criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinado}.

Fallo crítico As failure, and the criatura must spend each of its actions on its turn to move closer to the nosoi as expediently as possible while avoiding obvious dangers. If a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinado} criatura is adjacent to the nosoi, it stays still and doesn't act. If the criatura is attacked, the fascination ends.

action->Consume Flesh.name: Consumir carne
action->Consume Flesh.description:
Requisitos The esobok ghoul is adjacent to the corpse of a criatura that died within the last hour.

Efecto The ghoul devours a chunk of the corpse and regains @Damage[3d6[healing]] Puntos de Golpe.

It can regain Puntos de Golpe from any given corpse only once.

action->Corrupted Touch.name: Corrupted Touch
action->Corrupted Touch.description: An esobok ghoul's Golpes deal @Damage[1d6[void]] daño to living criaturas. A criatura critically hit by an esobok ghoul's Golpe must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:18] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drenado 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drenado 2} on a critical failure) as rot spreads throughout their flesh.

action->Ghoul Fever.name: Ghoul Fever
action->Ghoul Fever.description:
Tirada de salvación @Check[fortitude|dc:22]

Stage 1 carrier with no ill effect (1 day)

Stage 2 @Damage[2d6[void]] daño and regains half as many Puntos de Golpe from all healing (1 day)

Stage 3 as stage 2 (1 day)

Stage 4 @Damage[2d6[void]] daño and gains no benefit from healing (1 day)

Stage 5 as stage 4 (1 day)

Stage 6 dead, and rises as a ghoul the next midnight.

action->Paralysis.name: Paralysis
action->Paralysis.description:
Any living, non-elf criatura hit by a ghoul's attack must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:22] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralizado}.

It can attempt a new save at the end of each of its turns, and the DC cumulatively decreases by 1 on each such save.

action->Pounce.name: Pounce
action->Pounce.description: The esobok ghoul Strides and then makes a claw Golpe. If it began this action hidden, it remains hidden until after the Golpe.

action->Lifesense 60 feet.name:
<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.sebk9XseMCRkDqRg]
Lifesense 60 pies

action->Truespeech.name: Habla verdadera
action->Truespeech.description: The haunted nosoi speaks in Requian, the language of psychopomps, but all criaturas hear its words in their native languages.

action->Vengeful Burst.name: Vengeful Burst
action->Vengeful Burst.description:
Desencadenante The haunted nosoi is destroyed or it enters a square adjacent to a corrupted psychopomp in area D5

Efecto The haunted nosoi dies as it explodes into a burst of vitality energy. Este heals all living criaturas within 10 pies for @Damage[3d6[vitality]] daño.If triggered in area D5, the Vengeful Burst deals @Damage[2d12[void]] daño to any corrupted psychopomps in that area (@Check[will|dc:18|basic] save)

spell->Gentle Repose.name:
<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.xRgU9rrhmGAgG4Rc]
Gentle Repose

spell->Inveigle.target: 1 criatura of a level no greater than double the inveigle ritual's level

spell->Light.target: 1 object of 1 Bulk or less, either unattended or possessed by tú or a willing ally

<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.J7Y7tl0bbdz7TcCc]
Ray of Enfeeblement

action->Site Bound.name: Site Bound
action->Site Bound.description: Ioseff Xarwin esta vinculado al lugar de su laboratorio.

action->Recoil.name: Recoil
action->Recoil.description:
If a character forcefully presents Fulvia's ring to Ioseff as an action with the manipulate rasgo, he must attempt a @Check[will|dc:26] save; he's thereafter immune to Recoil for 24 hours.

Éxito crítico Ioseff is unaffected.

Éxito Ioseff takes @Damage[4d6[mental]] daño and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado 1}.

Fallo Ioseff takes @Damage[8d6[mental]] daño and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado 2}.

Fallo crítico Ioseff takes @Damage[8d6[mental]] daño, is asustado 2, and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Aturdido 3}.

action->Rejuvenation.name: Rejuvenecimiento
action->Rejuvenation.description:
Cuando un fantasma es destruido, ello re-forms after [[/br 2d4 #days]]{2d4 days} dentro de el location ello's bound a, fully healed. Un fantasma puede be permanently destruido solo si someone determines el reason for su existence y sets right whatever prevents el espiritual de resting.

In order a put Ioseff a rest, el following three conditions debe be met after defeating Ioseff but before el rejuvenates:

  • El muertos vivientes brain collector en area D6 tiene been destruido.
  • El brains de su wife y children tienen been freed de el brain collector statue, allowing su souls a mover a el Boneyard.
  • El Void Mirror tiene been replaced en su frame en el Cosmic Crypt.

action->Shame.name: Shame
action->Shame.description: Ioseff takes a -1 penalización por objeto to tiradas de ataque and tiradas de salvación against a character who carries Fulvia's ring. Este penalización doubles to -2 against a character who wears Fulvia's ring. At the start of ttheir turn, a character who possesses Fulvia's ring can attempt a secret @Check[perception|dc:20|traits:secret] check; on a success, they sense a faint compulsion fueled by outrage to present Fulvia's ring to the ghost.

action->Incite Insurrection.name: Incite Insurrection
action->Incite Insurrection.description:
Desencadenante A criatura within 30 pies of Ioseff fails a tirada de salvación against one of his conjuros

Efecto Ioseff infuses the magic of his conjuro with the agonies of his own death. In addition to any effects caused by the triggering conjuro, el objetivo must also attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:28|traits:disease] save. or contract internal insurrection at stage 1 (stage 2 on a critical failure)

Internal Insurrection (disease); Level 7.

El objetivo can't recover from the torpe condition from internal insurrection until the disease is cured

Stage 1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Torpe 1} (1 day)

Stage 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Torpe 2} (1 day)

Stage 3 torpe 2 and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} (1 day)

Stage 4 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Torpe 3} and desprevenido (1 day)

Stage 5 death, and el objetivo's body splits apart into a mass of fragments that crawls outward in a 10-pies-emanation before perishing, leaving a bare skeleton surrounded by gore.

action->Malevolent Possession.name: Malevolent Possession
action->Malevolent Possession.description:
Ioseff Xarwin attempts to possess an adjacent corporeal criatura. Este has the same effect as the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wU6hNzK8Yfqdmc8m]{Possession} conjuro, except since Ioseff Xarwin doesn't have a physical body, it is unaffected by that restriction of the conjuro.

El objetivo must attempt a @Check[will|dc:28|traits:controlling] save.

Éxito crítico El objetivo is unaffected.

Éxito Tú possess el objetivo but can't control it. Tú ride along in the body while the conjuro lasts.

Fallo Tú possess el objetivo and take partial control of it. Tú no longer have a separate turn; instead, tú might control el objetivo. At the start of each of el objetivo's turns, it attempts another Will save. If it fails, it's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9qGBRpbX9NEwtAAr]{Controlado} by tú on that turn; if it succeeds, it chooses its own actions; and if it critically succeeds, it forces tú out and the conjuro ends.

Fallo crítico Tú possess el objetivo fully, and it can only watch as tú manipulate it like a puppet. El objetivo is Controlled by tú.

A character who carries Fulvia's ring on their person gains a +4 bonificador por objeto to their save and treats the result of the save as one degree of success better than their rolled result. If Ioseff attempts to use this ability on a character who wears Fulvia's ring, he can attempt a Perception check against the ring-wearer's STEALTH DC to notice the ring in time to avoid the attempt; on a success, he loses the two actions he took to make the attempt but avoids further effects. If he doesn't notice the ring and attempts to possess the ring-wearer, the ring-wearer automatically gains a critical success on their Will save, Ioseff is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Aturdido 3}, and he can't use Malevolent Possession again for 24 hours.

action->Phantasmal Amputation.name: Phantasmal Amputation
action->Phantasmal Amputation.description:
Frecuencia una vez al día

Efecto Ioseff holds up the stump of his left arm, and the streaming blood begins to form a ghostly hand that he then uses to point out a humanoid criatura within 30 pies. That criatura must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:28|traits:necromancy,occult] save.

Éxito crítico The criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Indispuesto 1} by a sudden, agonizing pain in their left hand.

Éxito As critical success, but the criatura also takes @Damage[2d6[slashing]] daño and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Torpe 1} for 1 round as they feel as if their left hand just got lopped off by a hatchet.

Fallo The criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Indispuesto 2}, takes @Damage[5d6[slashing]] daño, and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Torpe 2} for 1 minute as they feel as if their left hand just got lopped off by a hatchet.

Fallo crítico The PC is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Indispuesto 3} and takes @Damage[8d6[slashing],2d6[bleed]]{8d6 daño cortante and 2d6 daño de sangrado} as their left hand appears to detach and fall to the floor before instantly decaying into bones. The PC is torpe 2 and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Yl48xTdMh3aeQYL2]{Herido 1}. As soon as this wounded condition is removed, the PC's hand miraculously returns and the torpe condition ends.

action->Tremorsense (Precise) 30 feet.name:
<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.j2wsK6IsW5yMW1jW]
Tremorsense (Precise) 30 pies

action->Clever Disguises.name: Clever Disguises
action->Clever Disguises.description: Ixirizmid can use DECEPTION to impersonate any Medium humanoid criatura, although creating such a disguise takes 1 hour. They can't impersonate a specific individual with this ability.

action->No Breath.name: No Breath
action->No Breath.description: Ixirizmid no respira y es inmune un effects que require breathing (such as un inhaled veneno).

action->Eviscerate.name: Eviscerate
action->Eviscerate.description:
Ixirizmid performs a swift and painful surgery on a criatura it has grabbed or restrained, or who's otherwise immobilized. They roll a @Check[medicine|defense:fortitude] check against el objetivo's Fortitude DC. Regardless of the result, el objetivo then becomes temporarily immune to Eviscerate for 24 hours.

Éxito crítico El objetivo takes @Damage[8d6[slashing]] daño, is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Lentificado 1} for 1 round, and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Torpe 1}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Debilitado 1}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Anonadado 1} (the mi-go chooses) for 24 hours.

Lured to Ashes.name: Lured to Ashes
Lured to Ashes.description: El illusory scene de un furnished study covers el sala's actual appearance. It flickers y fades, revealing un scorched y burnt camara. Un moment later, el screams de burning victims fill el sala, y blazing skeletal arms reach de el ashes y charred muros a scrape y garra.

Lured to Ashes.reset: 8 horas; destroying el tanglebones en area E3 destroys este haunt forever.
Lured to Ashes.routine:
1 Action: If there are no targets within area B18 when the haunt takes its action, it can use its Lure reaction to try to get nearby victims back inside. The haunt manifests several burning skeletal arms that reach up from the ruined floors or out of the burnt walls to claw at every criatura in area B18. Estos criaturas must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:22|name:Lured to Ashes Fire|traits:damaging-effect,fire,necromancy,occult] save (criaturas seated on a sofa take a -2 penalización de circunstancia to this tirada de salvación).

Éxito crítico The criatura takes no daño.

Fallo crítico As failure, but @Damage[4d8[fire]] daño and weakness 10 to fire.

action->Lure.name: Lure
action->Lure.description:

Each criatura must attempt a @Check[will|dc:22|name:Lure to Ashes] save (criaturas outside of area B18 gain a +2 bonificador de circunstancia to this save). On a failure, the criatura is compelled to move into area B18 and be seated on one of the sofas.

Las criaturas who succeed at the save aren't compelled and see the room as the burnt ruin that it is. The haunt then rolls initiative.

Mouth of Tchekuth.name: Mouth of Tchekuth
Mouth of Tchekuth.description: El chasm below shifts y ripples, transforming into un vast, gaping mouth filled con countless sharp colmillos. Un puckered, rasping tongue lances up de el noxious gulping depths below a lash y taste. Two words boom up de el vast throat below: "Iö Tchekuth!"

action->Hungry Tongue.description:
Desencadenante a criatura crosses the chasm

Éxito crítico The criatura realizes the haunt is a frightening phantasm that can't actually hurt them and is unharmed.

Éxito The criatura dodges the rasping tongue but falls from the bridge as a result, taking 10 daño from the fall (the criatura can GRAB an Edge with a successful @Check[reflex|dc:24|name:Grab an Edge|traits:damaging-effect] save).

Fallo For a brief moment, the criatura feels the awful touch of the rasping tongue as it brushes against them, licking away memories and causing the criatura to become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Anonadado 1} for 24 hours. The criatura then falls (as success above).

The criatura becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Anonadado 2} for 24 hours, during which time they can't remember their name. The criatura also increases the value of their malevolence condition by 1 and then falls (as success above).

Tanglebones.name: Tanglebones
Tanglebones.publicNotes:
Sometimes, cuando murderer buries un grande number de victims en un mass grave, el vengeful espiritus de el slain puede quedan similarly tangled together. Cuando these espiritus puede't untangle, ellos instead return a su physical remains, fusing into one horrific mass de huesos y black, tar-like sludge-un tanglebones.

One awful tale speaks de un bitter viejo dowager who learned que, through un legal loophole, ownership de su estate would revert a su estranged daughter. She murdered su 13 servants, buried su bodies en el house's basement, y then played el gracious mother en handing over el manor keys at el appointed time. One night, el tanglebones que arose de el dowager's atrocity murdered el daughter y su family. By el time el authorities learned de what happened, el dowager had fled el nation, changed su identity, y (el story goes) wasted no time rebuilding su fortunes-este time becoming un queen.

action->Eerie Flexibility.name: Eerie Flexibility
action->Eerie Flexibility.description: A tanglebones can shift and adjust its mass to fit into smaller areas, allowing it to fit through tight spaces as if it were a Medium criatura. While Squeezing, it can move at its full Velocidad.

action->Sprawled Bones.description: Until the next time it acts, the tanglebones appears as a sprawling mass of bones. It has an automatic result of 35 on DECEPTION checks and DCs to pass as a grisly but seemingly harmless mess.

Efecto The caul immediately bursts like an oily bubble, vanishing in an instant of foul-smelling smoke. A wave of susurration creeps through the area, and all sapient criaturas experience a sudden sensation of utter hatred toward birdlife for the span of a single heartbeat. All natural avians within a @Template[emanation|distance:300] from Xarwin Manor (but not those within the manor or underground) take @Damage[15d6[mental]] daño (@Check[fortitude|dc:33|basic|name:Xarwin Caul] save).

Xarwin Manor Phantasm.name: Xarwin Manor Phantasm
Xarwin Manor Phantasm.description:
The malevolence manifests a disturbing illusion meant to unsettle and erode intruders' resistances to the manor's dangers. Roll [[/r 1d12]] on the Xarwin Manor Phantasms table to determine what sort of illusion occurs; alternatively, pick an appropriate one from the table or create one of tu own using the listed results as examples or inspiration.

Xarwin Manor Phantasms

[[/r 1d12]] Phantasm
1 A damp, ectoplasmic handprint appears on a window or wall, only to reach out of the surface briefly to try to choke a character. The hand vanishes a moment later, but the PC's left hand feels weirdly damp until it's wiped off.
2 A painless, bloodless incision manifests across a PC's forehead, completely encircling their skull over a few seconds; when the incision completes its circuit, the PC experiences a momentarily excruciating headache before the incision vanishes.
3 The PC catches a glimpse of a shadowy figure in a reflective surface; the figure raises an arm as if to point at them, yet the arm has no hand. When the PC turns to confront the image or blinks, the figure is gone.
4 The PC stumbles then notices that loose objects in the room shake, curtains swing, and floorboards shift. If a window is visible, the trees outside sway even though it's a windless day. As everything grows still, the PC gets the feeling that something immense just shifted somewhere down below. No other PC experiences this sensation.
5 The PC feels a sudden pain on their left wrist and is convinced that their hand has been cut off. Upon looking at the suspected wound, the pain vanishes and the hand looks fine.
6 The sky through a window appears to be fully night during the day, or the ceiling above suddenly fades away to reveal the night sky. The PC feels something looking back at them from somewhere between the stars, but as soon as they blink, look away, or draw attention to the night sky, the image reverts to normal.
7 The PC is suddenly overcome with the conviction that they've lived in this manor for decades and that the other PCs are trespassers, only for the feeling to vanish moments later.
8 The PC suddenly feels an overwhelming sense of betrayal from one of the other PCs-preferably the one with which they have the closest emotional ties. A heartbeat later, the feeling fades away.
9 The PC can hear what sounds like a small bird trapped in a wall, struggling for escape; no other PC can hear it. A few moments later, the PC feels that they're the trapped bird, and then the phantasm fades away.
10 The PC suddenly loses all senses and feels weightless for a split second. In the darkness, they get the creeping thought that something is about to give them the gift of sight, but they know that what they'll see will be awful. Then, everything returns to normal.
11 The PC is, for a few frightening moments, suddenly convinced that someone else is thinking for them and that they've been tricked into thinking they're in their own body when they're not.
12 The PC suddenly remembers an awful memory from their past or childhood, then feels a sense of relief as that memory is pulled from their minds. They can remember that something bad happened but not what it was.

Éxito The criatura is unaffected and is temporarily immune to Compel Condemned for 24 hours.

Fallo The criatura must spend each of its actions to move closer to Yianyin as quickly as possible, while avoiding obvious dangers. If the compelled criatura is adjacent to Yianyin, it stays still and doesn't act. If the criatura takes any daño, the effect ends and the criatura is temporarily immune to Compel Condemned for 24 hours. Este effect lasts for 1 round, but if Yianyin uses this ability again on subsequent rounds, it extend the duration by 1 round for all affected criaturas.

Fallo crítico As failure, but daño does not end the effect.
